decoded.meaning: FIELD{ NAME "subscribers" } — :subscribers (index_mode absent ⇒ SCALAR, the whole-array read)
decoded.note: RFC-0004 §B/§C canonical bytes; structured TLV, opt.PL=1, no trailers (at-rest form). The index_mode VALUE is OPTIONAL and its absence is SCALAR by default, so this is `field-append` minus its 5-byte trailing VALUE. Completes the index_mode triple with field-append (ELEMENT) and field-wildcard (WILDCARD).
